title: Hiring Character Artist for Legends of Orisha
content: WE'RE HIRING! We're looking for a Character Artist to join the team working on Legends of Orisha: Blood and Water. author: dragon_trappers_lodge
title: Hiring Concept Artist for 3D Printable Miniatures
content: WE'RE HIRING: CONCEPT ARTIST! The position will entail creating 2d concept art for 3d printable fantasy miniatures. Concepts will need to be refined line art drawings. No rendering, color, or value work required. We pay $100/concept with more complex detailed creatures granting more pay on a case by case basis. All applications must be submitted through our official BambooHR hiring page, linked in our bio. We do not accept applications via Instagram DMs or comments.
